spec.title: Servers.com
spec.description: Servers.com Enterprise Bare Metal state from prometheus-serverscom-exporter.

spec.name: filters
spec.label: Filters
spec.description: Filters added to every query, for the extra labels the exporter puts on all its metrics (--label, e.g. account=prod). For Servers.com host labels use Label and Value: label_* exist only on serverscom_host_labels, so filtering them here empties the other panels.

spec.name: show
spec.label: Show
spec.description: Problems only hides servers in order on Racks and Servers: what is left is powered off, not operational, or degraded (a power feed down or a redundant uplink not aggregated).

spec.name: rack
spec.label: Rack

spec.query: query_result(label_replace(label_join(count_values by (rack) ("n", count by (rack) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location"}) and on (rack) count by (rack) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location"} and on (host_id) (max by (host_id, title) ( label_replace(serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location"} * 0, "check", "base", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_power_feed_up{location=~"$location"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "feeds", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location"} == 1 and serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "uplinks", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_operational_status{location=~"$location", status!="normal"}) > bool 0), "check", "operational", "", "") or label_replace(3 * (1 - serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location"}), "check", "power", "", "") ) >= $show))), "display", " · ", "rack", "n"), "display", "$1 servers", "display", "(.*)"))

spec.definition: query_result(label_replace(label_join(count_values by (rack) ("n", count by (rack) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location"}) and on (rack) count by (rack) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location"} and on (host_id) (max by (host_id, title) ( label_replace(serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location"} * 0, "check", "base", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_power_feed_up{location=~"$location"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "feeds", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location"} == 1 and serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "uplinks", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_operational_status{location=~"$location", status!="normal"}) > bool 0), "check", "operational", "", "") or label_replace(3 * (1 - serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location"}), "check", "power", "", "") ) >= $show))), "display", " · ", "rack", "n"), "display", "$1 servers", "display", "(.*)"))
spec.description: Racks of the selected locations; with Show = Problems only, just the racks with a problem.

spec.name: label
spec.label: Label
spec.description: Servers.com label to filter servers by (label_* of serverscom_host_labels). Pick its values in Value.

spec.name: label_value
spec.label: Value
spec.description: Values of the selected label. All keeps servers without the label too.

spec.name: server
spec.label: Server

spec.query: query_result(count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} unless on (host_id) serverscom_host_labels{label_$label!~"$label_value"}))

spec.definition: query_result(count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} unless on (host_id) serverscom_host_labels{label_$label!~"$label_value"}))
spec.description: Servers by current name, filtered by location, rack and label; selected by host_id, so a renamed server stays selected. All means all servers that pass the filters.

spec.name: currency
spec.label: Currency
spec.description: Currencies of the service prices; used in panel titles.

spec.title: Powered off
spec.description: Servers whose power_status is not powered_on.

spec.title: Not operational
spec.description: Servers whose operational_status is not "normal".

spec.title: Power feeds down
spec.description: Power feeds that are not on, over all selected servers.

spec.title: Uplinks split
spec.description: Redundant uplinks whose ports were split with the disaggregated_*_ports feature.

spec.expr: count(serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0 and serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Account rate limit
spec.description: Paused: the account-wide X-RateLimit-Remaining is at the exporter's --api.ratelimit-reserve and it waits for the window reset (serverscom_api_ratelimit_paused). Exceeds: at its current rate (last 15 minutes, capped by its budget) the exporter reaches the reserve before the reset. Requests of other API users are not projected.

spec.expr: (2 * max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_paused) > 0) or (1 - (((max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_remaining) - (max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_reserve) or vector(0))) - (clamp_max(sum(rate(serverscom_api_requests_total[15m])) or vector(0), scalar(max(serverscom_api_requests_budget_per_hour) / 3600)) * clamp_min(max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_reset_timestamp_seconds) - time(), 0))) >= bool 0))

spec.title: Headroom until reset
spec.description: Requests left above the reserve at the window reset if the exporter keeps its current rate. Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its --api.requests-per-hour budget), projected until X-RateLimit-Reset, compared with X-RateLimit-Remaining minus the exporter's reserve. Below zero the exporter will hit the reserve and pause before the window resets. Requests of other API users of the account are not projected.

spec.title: Exporter requests until reset
spec.description: Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its budget) multiplied by the time left until the reset.

spec.title: Remaining (account)
spec.description: X-RateLimit-Remaining: requests left in the window for the whole account.

spec.title: Window resets in
spec.description: Time until X-RateLimit-Reset.

spec.title: Exporter budget
spec.description: Whether the exporter used up its own --api.requests-per-hour budget in the current hourly window and waits for the reset.

spec.title: Estimated demand per hour
spec.description: Requests per hour the configured refresh intervals need for the current number of servers, segments and racks (serverscom_exporter_requests_per_hour_estimated). Above the budget the exporter uses up --api.requests-per-hour and waits for the hourly reset; the log then recommends flags.

spec.title: Full download cost
spec.description: Requests needed to download all information once, e.g. after a start without a cache file.

spec.title: Servers per rack
spec.description: Selected servers by rack.

spec.title: Servers
spec.description: One row per server. Uplinks: aggregated = redundant uplink with ports in a LAG; disaggregated = redundant uplink split with the disaggregated_*_ports feature; single link = no redundancy. With Show = Problems only, just the servers that are powered off, not operational or degraded.

spec.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack, configuration, private_ipv4, public_ipv4, oob_ipv4) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}) and on (host_id) (max by (host_id, title) ( label_replace(serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} * 0, "check", "base", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_power_feed_up{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "feeds", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 1 and serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "uplinks", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_operational_status{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", status!="normal"}) > bool 0), "check", "operational", "", "") or label_replace(3 * (1 - serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}), "check", "power", "", "") ) >= $show)

max by (host_id) (max by (host_id, title) ( label_replace(serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} * 0, "check", "base", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_power_feed_up{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "feeds", "", "") or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 1 and serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "uplinks", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_operational_status{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", status!="normal"}) > bool 0), "check", "operational", "", "") or label_replace(3 * (1 - serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}), "check", "power", "", "") ))
max by (host_id, server_model, operating_system) (serverscom_host_configuration_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"})

max by (host_id) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", uplink="public"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", uplink="public"})

max by (host_id) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", uplink="private"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", uplink="private"})

properties.value: OK; Degraded: a power feed is down or a redundant uplink is not aggregated; Not operational; Powered off.
Public uplink: LAG: redundant uplink, ports aggregated. SPL: redundant uplink split with the disaggregated_public_ports feature. SGL: single link.
Private uplink: LAG: redundant uplink, ports aggregated. SPL: redundant uplink split with the disaggregated_private_ports feature. SGL: single link.
YES: the OOB interface is reachable from the internet (oob_public_access is active).

spec.title: OOB
spec.description: OOB address and the status of the oob_public_access feature (public access to the OOB interface).

spec.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack, oob_ipv4) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"})

max by (host_id, oob_status) (label_replace(serverscom_host_feature_status{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", feature="oob_public_access"}, "oob_status", "$1", "status", "(.*)"))

serverscom_host_uplink_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} * on (host_id, uplink) group_left () (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"})

spec.title: L2 segments
spec.description: Segments with at least one member among the selected servers.

spec.expr: serverscom_l2_segment_info * on (segment_id) group_left () count by (segment_id) (serverscom_l2_segment_member_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"})

(serverscom_host_drive_slot_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} * on (host_id, position) group_left () serverscom_host_drive_capacity{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}) or (serverscom_host_drive_slot_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", populated="false"} * 0)

properties.value: drive_model.capacity as reported by the API (most likely GB); 0 for empty slots.

spec.title: API rate limit (account-wide)
spec.description: X-RateLimit-* headers of API responses; the limit is shared by all API users of the account.

spec.title: Headroom until reset (forecast)
spec.description: Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its --api.requests-per-hour budget), projected until X-RateLimit-Reset, compared with X-RateLimit-Remaining minus the exporter's reserve. Below zero the exporter will hit the reserve and pause before the window resets. Requests of other API users of the account are not projected.

spec.title: Budget used
spec.description: Requests in the current hourly window of the exporter's own budget.

spec.title: Budget remaining
spec.description: Requests left in the current hourly window of --api.requests-per-hour.

spec.title: Budget resets in
spec.description: Time until the exporter's budget window resets; 0 when no window is open.

spec.title: Budget used up (24h)
spec.description: Hourly budget windows the exporter used up during the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Budget per hour
spec.description: --api.requests-per-hour

spec.title: Recommended budget
spec.description: Recommended --api.requests-per-hour.

spec.title: Refresh loops
spec.description: Per refresh loop: the configured interval, the effective one (stretched when the loops do not fit into 80% of the request budget), requests per hour at the effective interval, and how old the data is. Age / interval above 3 is what the ServerscomExporterDataStale alert fires on.

spec.title: Estimated demand per hour
spec.description: Requests per hour by loop at the effective intervals (stacked), the exporter budget, and what the configured intervals would need. A gap between the last two means the intervals are stretched.

spec.title: Cost this period
spec.description: Sum of serverscom_host_service_price of the selected servers: the current billing period, tax included. Needs the services collector. The API updates prices once a day.

spec.title: Stale data
spec.description: Collectors not refreshed for more than three refresh intervals (same rule as the ServerscomExporterDataStale alert). See the Exporter tab.

spec.title: Server models
spec.description: Selected servers by server model.

spec.title: Total this period
spec.description: Current billing period, tax included, of the selected servers.

spec.title: Average per server
spec.description: Total divided by the number of selected servers that have services.

spec.expr: sum by (currency) (serverscom_host_service_price{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}) / count by (currency) (count by (host_id, currency) (serverscom_host_service_price{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}))

spec.title: Most expensive server
spec.description: The selected server with the highest total in the current billing period.

spec.expr: topk(1, sum by (title, currency) (serverscom_host_service_price{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}))

spec.title: Servers without prices
spec.description: Selected servers with no services: just ordered (they appear on the next invoice), not downloaded yet, or the services collector is disabled.

spec.expr: count(serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} unless on (host_id) serverscom_host_service_price) or vector(0)

spec.title: By rack, $currency
spec.description: Total of the current billing period by rack.

spec.title: By server model, $currency
spec.description: Total of the current billing period by server model.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by (server_model) (serverscom_host_service_price{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} * on (host_id) group_left (server_model) max by (host_id, server_model) (serverscom_host_configuration_info)))

spec.title: By service type, $currency
spec.description: Total of the current billing period by service type (server_base, bandwidth, ...).

spec.title: Cost per server
spec.description: Current billing period of each selected server. Total includes tax.

spec.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"})

spec.title: Services
spec.description: Billed services of the selected servers in the current billing period. Services with the same name and type on one server are summed by the exporter.

spec.title: Cost over time, $currency
spec.description: Total of the selected servers. Steps show new or released servers and the start of a billing period.

spec.title: Interval stretch
spec.description: How much the refresh intervals are stretched to fit into 80% of the exporter's request budget (serverscom_exporter_refresh_interval_stretch_factor). ×1 means the configured intervals fit; above, every loop but the server list runs that much less often. Raise --api.requests-per-hour or the intervals.

spec.title: ${rack:text}
spec.description: Servers of the rack, problems first (powered off, not operational, degraded), then by name, one row of the same height per server (the API does not report rack units, so rows are not real rack positions). Green: OK. Orange: degraded (a power feed is down or a redundant uplink is not aggregated). Red: not operational. Dark red: powered off. The panel fits 8 servers; a rack with more scrolls. With Show = Problems only, servers in order are hidden. Click a server to filter the dashboard by it.

spec.expr:
(
max by (host_id, title) (
  label_replace(serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} * 0, "check", "base", "", "")
  or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_power_feed_up{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "feeds", "", "")
  or label_replace(1 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} == 1 and serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} == 0) > bool 0), "check", "uplinks", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (count by (host_id, title) (serverscom_host_operational_status{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", status!="normal"}) > bool 0), "check", "operational", "", "")
  or label_replace(3 * (1 - serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"}), "check", "power", "", "")
)
) >= $show

spec.title: OOB public access
spec.description: Servers whose OOB interface (iDRAC/iLO) is reachable from the internet: the oob_public_access feature is active.

spec.title: Release scheduled
spec.description: Servers scheduled to be released: they and their data go away at the release date. Abort in the portal if unexpected.

spec.title: Rescue mode
spec.description: Servers booted into rescue mode (the host_rescue_mode feature is active).

spec.title: Needs attention
spec.description: One row per problem of a selected server, critical first: powered off, operational status not normal, OOB reachable from the internet, release scheduled (critical); a power feed down, split bonding of a redundant uplink, rescue mode (warning). Click a server to filter the dashboard by it.

spec.expr:
max by (host_id, title, location, rack, issue) (
  label_replace((serverscom_host_powered_on{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0) * 0 + 3, "issue", "powered off", "", "")
  or label_replace((serverscom_host_operational_status{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", status!="normal"}) * 0 + 2, "issue", "operational status: $1", "status", "(.*)")
  or label_replace((serverscom_host_feature_enabled{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", feature="oob_public_access"} == 1) * 0 + 2, "issue", "OOB reachable from the internet", "", "")
  or label_replace((serverscom_host_scheduled_release_timestamp_seconds{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"}) * 0 + 2, "issue", "release scheduled", "", "")
  or label_replace((serverscom_host_power_feed_up{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0) * 0 + 1, "issue", "power feed $1 down", "feed", "(.*)")
  or label_replace((serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 0 and on (host_id, uplink) serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server"} == 1) * 0 + 1, "issue", "$1 bonding split", "uplink", "(.*)")
  or label_replace((serverscom_host_feature_enabled{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", host_id=~"$server", feature="host_rescue_mode"} == 1) * 0 + 1, "issue", "rescue mode", "", "")
)

spec.title: Servers by $label
spec.description: Selected servers by the Servers.com label chosen in Label; (none) means the server has no such label.
